name: What types of ceiling textures can be matched during a drywall repair?

mainEntity.name: What types of ceiling textures can be matched during a drywall repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Professionals can match a wide variety of ceiling textures during drywall repair to ensure a seamless blend. Common textures include smooth, knockdown, popcorn (acoustic), orange peel, and various hand-troweled finishes. Achieving an exact match often requires skill and specialized tools, especially for older or custom textures. We strive to recreate the existing texture so the repaired area is undetectable.
acceptedAnswer.description: Many textures like smooth, knockdown, popcorn, and orange peel can be matched by professionals.
